name: After § 15
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: 15a. Highlights the need for fair, progressive and efficient tax systems as a key component of sustainable and socially balanced fiscal policies; stresses that tax reforms should reduce inequalities, protect low- and middle-income households and ensure that the green and digital transitions are financed in a socially just manner; calls on the Member States to tackle tax avoidance, aggressive tax planning and tax fraud; calls for further coordinated steps to ensure proper taxation of large multinational enterprises, including digital business models; stresses that public revenue could be used to help address Member States’ fiscal challenges, as well as contribute to the long-term sustainability of social protection systems, support public investment and social resilience and ensure a more equitable distribution of wealth;
